senses.gloss: m.(b. h. אֱשׁוּן; v. אשן, עשן)dense vapor, steam; vapor-room in the bath (sudatio).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 4:4:4">Y. Ned. IV, 38ᵈ</cite> top he who bathes in the small caldarium (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Baths) <he>נסב א׳</he> takes away vapor (and does not benefit his fellow-bather by his presence).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 8:2:5">Y. Shebi. VIII, 38ᵃ</cite> top <he>אעלליה לי לא׳</he> take it up for me to the vapor-room.
